panels.title: Radios
panels.description: Every AP radio, now. Channel is the primary channel (Channels: the bonded set). Tx power level 1 is the radio's maximum. Channel busy (CCA) is the share of time the radio heard the channel busy: its own transmit, receive from its clients and everything else; RRM measures it every 180 s. Tx/rx are the radio's own traffic over the last 3 minutes. Known gap: the WLC's telemetry drops the first entry of each list; extra per-entry subscriptions restore the 2.4 GHz radio and the lowest WLAN, but the client with the lowest MAC and the 2.4 GHz noise/interference scan stay missing; see wireless.py.

import "join"
ap_names = from(bucket: "wlc")

  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-access-point-oper:access-point-oper-data/radio-oper-data" and (r._field == "current_active_band" or r._field == "oper_state" or r._field == "admin_state" or r._field == "phy_ht_cfg/cfg_data/curr_freq" or r._field == "phy_ht_cfg/cfg_data/freq_string" or r._field == "phy_ht_cfg/cfg_data/chan_width" or r._field == "phy_ht_cfg/cfg_data/rrm_channel_change_reason" or r._field == "bss_color_cfg/bss_color") and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/)

  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-access-point-oper:access-point-oper-data/ap-name-mac-map" and r._field == "wtp_mac" and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({source: r.source, wtp_mac: r._value, ap: r.wtp_name}))
radio_bands = from(bucket: "wlc")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "Cisco-IOS-XE-wireless-access-point-oper:access-point-oper-data/radio-oper-data" and r._field == "current_active_band" and r.source =~ /^${wlc:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({source: r.source, wtp_mac: r.wtp_mac, radio_slot_id: r.radio_slot_id, band: r._value}))

    on: (l, r) => l.source == r.source and l.wtp_mac == r.wtp_mac,
    as: (l, r) => ({l with ap: if exists r.ap then r.ap else l.wtp_mac}))
